app.title: Shampoore Panel
app.subtitle: Control plane
app.tagline: Everything is configured in a few clicks.

dashboard.healthHint: Live status of your relays and exits.
dashboard.statusHint: Live state of every Relay and Exit.
dashboard.domainHint: Point a DNS record at this server — Caddy gets a certificate automatically.
dashboard.caddyOk: Caddy configuration is up to date.
dashboard.caddyPending: Add a domain to issue an HTTPS certificate automatically.
dashboard.urlOverride: The public URL is fixed by the panel startup flag.
dashboard.subscriptionsHint: When disabled, users only receive the offline config.
dashboard.confirmDeleteDomain: Delete the subscription domain? The Caddy HTTPS configuration will be removed.

nodes.title: Servers
nodes.subtitle: Relay accepts client connections. Exit sends traffic to the internet.
nodes.empty: No servers yet. Add a Relay to get started.
nodes.name: Name
nodes.authHint: Provide a private SSH key OR a password for the connection. Credentials are stored only in the local panel database.
nodes.domainRequired: Every enabled transport needs a domain
nodes.toggleServices: Start or stop all services on this server
nodes.confirmStopServices: Stop all services on "{name}"? Users connected through this server will be disconnected.
nodes.transportsRelayOnly: Transports are available for servers with the Relay role.
nodes.allTransportsAdded: All available transports have already been added
nodes.duplicateTransport: This transport is already added to the server
nodes.encryptionHint: Every transport uses XChaCha20-Poly1305 with this password.
nodes.decoyRepoHint: Provide a public GitHub repository with index.html, style.css and app.js. If the field is empty, no decoy site is deployed.
nodes.secretsHint: Secrets are stored in the panel database and pushed to the server on deploy. Use 🎲 to regenerate a value.
nodes.deleteConfirmBody: Delete "{name}"? The panel will stop containers, remove volumes, /opt/shampoore and systemd units, then delete the database record.
nodes.deleteForceOption: Server is unreachable — delete the database record only
nodes.deleteForceHint: Enable this when the VPS is already gone or SSH is unavailable. Nothing will be removed on the server.

routes.title: Routes
routes.subtitle: A route connects one Relay to one Exit over a transport.
routes.empty: No routes yet. Connect a Relay to an Exit.
routes.name: Name
routes.hint: The Exit node is redeployed automatically after changes.
routes.transportTaken: Already configured for this server pair
routes.subRoutesRequired: Select at least two single routes
routes.noSubRoutes: Create at least two single routes first
routes.multiHint: A multi-route combines existing single routes; the relay and exit are taken from them.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Each user gets a personal subscription link and QR code.
users.empty: No users yet. Create the first subscription.
users.name: Name
users.speedHint: 0 means unlimited. 1024 = 1 MB/s. The cap is shared by all devices of the user.
users.speedInvalid: The speed limit must not be negative
users.noRoutes: No routes yet. The user will access all future routes.
users.noPublicURL: Set the subscription domain on the Dashboard first.
users.qrHint: Scan this QR code in the client app or share the link.
users.offlineHint: Import this JSON into the client if the network subscription is unavailable.
users.offlineOnly: Network subscription delivery is disabled — only the offline config is available.
users.bundleEmpty: This user has no available routes yet.
users.noRoutesSelected: No routes selected — the user gets every route.
users.orderHint: Drag routes or use ▲▼. Subscription links follow this order.

server.confirmStop: Stop the local shampoore-server process managed by this panel? Only tunnels served by this process will drop; sessions through remote nodes keep running.

config.title: Configurations
config.subtitle: Advanced: local shampoore-server configs running on this panel host.
config.warningOffline: Server is offline. Configs will not run until you click “Start server”.
config.noActive: Server is running, but no configs are enabled.

dialog.name: Name
dialog.advancedHint: Extra parameters for this transport. Empty = use defaults.
dialog.exportHint: Share this URL to import the same config elsewhere.
dialog.invalidJson: Invalid JSON — cannot switch back to the form

confirm.deleteConfig: Delete this config? This cannot be undone.

rules.title: Geo rules
rules.hint: Manage GeoIP rules and CIDR lists.
rules.name: Rule name
rules.urlHint: Use a raw or GitHub blob link — blob links are converted to raw automatically.
rules.exitNodesHint: By default the rule applies to every Exit server.
rules.exitNodesRequired: Select at least one Exit server
rules.subtitle: GeoIP rules and CIDR lists applied to Exit servers.
rules.manualHint: This rule was added manually; refresh its CIDR list when needed.

update.failed: The panel did not come back in time
